[Angelia Miller](https://angeliamiller.github.io) is the owner and principal consultant for Maris Collaborative, LLC. She is a fisheries scientist by trade and an advocate for open and applied sciences. She finds joy in building reproducible and streamlined workflows in the data throughout the data life cycle.
